pascālis , e, adj. for pascualis, from pascuum,
I.pasturing, grazing: pascales oves Cato posuit pro pascuales, Fest. p. 243 Müll.; cf. id. ib. p. 242: pascali pecore ac montano, Lucil. ap. Fest. s. v. Solox, p. 301 Müll.; “boves pascuales,” Vulg. 3 Reg. 4, 23 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
